title: Meta is bringing its Muse AI agent to its glasses
excerpt: Meta is putting its fast-rising Muse AI agent into smart glasses, betting users will want an always-on assistant for daily tasks.
content_html:
By Pranav Dixit

You're currently following this author! Click to unsubscribe from email alerts.

Meta is bringing its hot new AI agent Muse to its smart glasses.

The move, announced Wednesday at its annual Connect conference in Menlo Park, California, gives Meta a new way to put Muse directly in front of users throughout the day.

Muse has become a fast-rising entrant in the increasingly competitive AI agent market: software that can take actions on a person's behalf, rather than merely answer questions or generate text. Instead of opening an app or sitting down at a computer, people could eventually ask Muse for help through a pair of glasses already on their face.

With a connection to your Muse personal AI agent, Meta's glasses "offer more ways than ever to help you manage daily life, whether you're building healthy habits or navigating a busy calendar, all without reaching for your phone," the company said in an announcement.

At Connect, CEO Mark Zuckerberg said the company will "start upgrading the AI experience on Meta glasses" in the coming weeks.

The announcement makes clear that the company sees its hardware business as important for the agent, which launched earlier this month and quickly rose to the top of the App Store charts, beating rivals like ChatGPT.

Meta's broader hardware blitz at Connect also included Ray-Ban Meta Audio, a new audio-focused pair of glasses. It said it expects to offer more than 100 styles across Ray-Ban, Oakley, and Meta Glasses by the end of the year. It also announced Meta VR Glasses, which it said will offer a more immersive way to watch movies, play games, and work in virtual reality, and will go on sale next spring.

Meta is waging a bigger battle over AI agents. Already, Muse can browse the web, make calls, shop, and handle other chores. Meta has also announced partnerships with companies including Shopify, PayPal, Expedia, and Instacart.

That puts Meta in a heated race with startups such as Instinct, an invite-only personal AI assistant founded by 23-year-old Noah Shinn. Instinct launched before Muse and quickly caught on with Silicon Valley, turning the tiny startup into an unlikely rival for Meta.

Personal AI agents are still early products, with uneven results. In a recent hands-on review, Business Insider's Katie Notopoulos found that Muse could help organize an inbox and identify subscriptions, while it struggled with school forms, medical scheduling, and some online checkouts.

Muse also faces resistance from the websites and services they are meant to navigate. Earlier this week, Amazon blocked Muse from its shopping site, signaling that some companies may not embrace agents as readily as users do.

Pranav Dixit 是《商业内幕》驻旧金山湾区的元记者。 他撰写了有关 Meta 的产品、政策和内部运作的文章，同时研究了该公司的决策如何影响数十亿人的联系和沟通方式。 此前，Pranav 是 BuzzFeed News 驻印度的技术记者，报道硅谷最大的公司对南亚超过 10 亿人的文化、社会和政治的影响。 他还曾担任 Engadget 的高级新闻编辑，并在印度最大的全国性报纸之一《印度斯坦时报》上进行科技报道。普拉纳夫的报道揭示了大型科技公司在新兴市场寻求增长对人类造成的后果，并引发了关于美国科技公司对全球南方影响的广泛讨论。 2019 年，他凭借一部关于 WhatsApp 错误信息如何在印度农村引发可怕私刑的实地专题报道，获得了锡拉丘兹大学的《镜报》奖。 他还从不稳定的地缘政治热点克什米尔进行报道，记录了世界上持续时间最长的互联网关闭。他的作品被主要国内和国际出版物广泛引用，并且他曾在 BBC、半岛电视台和 Vox Media 的 Land of the Giants 等播客上讨论他的作品。 他还在新闻课程中发表过演讲，包括加州大学伯克利分校的研究生新闻课程。 他的文章曾发表在《卫报》、《Vox》、《时代》、《信息》和半岛电视台上。Pranav 于 2021 年从印度新德里移居美国，成为哈佛大学尼曼新闻基金会的研究员，在那里他研究了美国科技媒体的演变以及世界各地的新闻编辑室如何更有效地报道技术和社会。有关于 Meta 或硅谷其他任何地方的建议吗？ 通过加密消息应用程序 Signal (+1408-905-9124) 联系 Pranav，或发送电子邮件至 pdixit@insider.com 或 pranavdixit@protonmail.com。 您还可以通过 WhatsApp +857-753-3949 联系他，或者通过 X (@PranavDixit) 或 BlueSky (@pranavdixit.bsky.social) 与他联系。Pranav 对消息来源保持匿名。 请使用非工作设备进行联系。专业知识：Meta、Facebook、WhatsApp、Llama、AI、Threads、Instagram、马克·扎克伯格、社交媒体、平台、移民
